summary: This 8-K reports short-term unsecured loans totaling $250,000 from The Donald P. Monaco Insurance Trust, made on June 25 and June 30, 2026. The loans extend a series commenced March 25, 2026, now totaling $950,000 principal, with 7.5% simple interest per annum, maturing July 15, 2026. The terms are straightforward: unsecured, short-term financing, with board and audit committee approval. This is a routine financial obligation, not a special situation. There are no strategic implications, no change in control, and no unusual terms that would classify it as a special situation.
